Job summary
An opportunity to join the Application Support team at Band 5 is available. The post-holder will provide support and training on key digital systems.

Person Specification
Qualifications and Knowledge
Essential
Educated to Degree standard or Equivalent
Desirable
Training qualification or considerable relevant experience within a training environment
An understanding of process mapping
In depth knowledge of Patient administration and clinical systems
Experience
Essential
Experience of training groups of learners with variable skill levels, managing group dynamics to ensure a positive outcome.
Experience providing application support
Experience of training administration such as scheduling courses, recording attendance, feedback from delegates and preparing all necessary materials and paperwork prior to courses
Experience of producing reports on training activity for audit purposes
Desirable
Experience of designing and delivering bespoke Clinical System training courses to support the Health Board's operational needs
Project management

good_statement:
I am applying for this Application Support Specialist role because it combines application support, user guidance, service continuity, and structured improvement in a public healthcare setting. My experience supporting a live web application and enterprise applications has developed my ability to investigate incidents, explain technical issues clearly, and maintain reliable records and documentation.

I hold an MSc in Information Technology with Distinction and a BSc in Information Technology. In application support, I have triaged incidents by reviewing logs, SQL data, configuration, and system behaviour. I have diagnosed authentication, access, application errors, and data inconsistencies, escalating complex issues when appropriate. This gives me a sound foundation for contributing to a second-line help-desk service and for learning the Health Board's clinical applications through the required training and supervised practice.

I have supported user onboarding and provided guidance to users with different levels of technical confidence. I adapt explanations, use clear steps, and maintain documentation so that users can resolve common issues consistently. My experience with technical documentation and knowledge-base resources would transfer to updating user guides, training materials, and e-learning content. My ERP project also required me to understand workflows across connected modules, investigate data consistency, and explain system behaviour to users.

I would bring careful analysis, dependable communication, and a learning-focused approach to acceptance testing, business change, and application support. My Google Advanced Data Analytics Professional Certificate and IBM Data Engineering Professional Certificate strengthen my knowledge of data validation, SQL, and structured investigation. I would use these skills responsibly while building direct knowledge of the Health Board's systems, policies, and operational requirements.
